actions.reasoning: CRITICAL RED FLAGS DETECTED: (1) Email sender shows 'security-alert@chase-notifications.net' - this is a PHISHING indicator. Legitimate Chase emails come from @chase.com domains, not third-party notification services. (2) The email uses urgent language ('Immediate Action Required', 'please secure your account immediately') - classic phishing tactic to bypass critical thinking. (3) The 'Secure My Account' button likely leads to a phishing site designed to steal credentials. (4) Legitimate banks never ask users to click links in emails to verify account security - they direct users to log in directly through the official website. (5) This email is a SCAM attempting to harvest Chase banking credentials.
